text: dsh-cache-hit-precision 是适用于 DSH Web 的界面插件，在 composer dock 注册不可见条目并读取会话 tokenUsage。它将底部统计行的缓存命中率原位精化到三位小数，并同步更新会话 Token 用量弹窗和无障碍标签；整数运算采用半进位，接近满命中时增加精度以避免显示成 100%。适合需要观察缓存命中率细微变化的 DSH Web 用户。无需额外密钥或配置。

A DSH Web plugin that shows composer cache-hit rates to three decimals. An invisible dock entry reads token usage and synchronizes the percentage in the session dialog and accessible labels. Integer rounding keeps partial hits below 100%. No extra key or configuration is needed.
想让 DSH Web 的缓存命中率显示得更精确一些。
DSH 底部统计行能不能把缓存命中率显示到小数点后三位？
让会话用量弹窗和状态行显示一致的精细缓存命中百分比。
我想看见接近 100% 时仍未命中的那部分输入 token。
Can DSH show cache hit rates with more precision in its composer stats?
I want the session usage dialog and status row to show the same precise cache-hit percentage.
dsh-cache-hit-precision 的功能「统计行精度显示」：读取会话 tokenUsage 并将 composer 统计行中的缓存命中率原位改为三位小数；命中率接近满值时继续增加精度，避免部分命中被显示成 100%。
dsh-cache-hit-precision 的功能「用量弹窗同步」：会话 Token 用量弹窗挂载或 React 更新行内容时，插件定位缓存命中行并更新百分比，保留其他用量桶的数值。
dsh-cache-hit-precision 的功能「精确计算缓存命中率」：把未缓存输入、缓存读取和缓存写入 token 相加作为分母，以缓存读取 token 为分子，使用整数半进位计算显示百分比；没有计费输入时不产生读数。
How can I make cache percentages easier to compare across sessions?
让 DSH 的缓存命中百分比在状态行和用量详情里保持一致。

一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/)（DSH）Web 插件：把底部
composer 统计行里的缓存命中率**原位精化到三位小数**（`缓存命中 98%` →
`缓存命中 98.460%`），并同步「Token 用量」弹窗与状态行中的同一读数。

dsh-cache-hit-precision README · dsh-cache-hit-precision：不新增任何可见内容：插件在 composer dock 里占一个不可见的席位，读取与内置
统计 pill 相同的 `tokenUsage` 投影，只改写缓存命中率这一个读数——轮次、步数、
速度、总量，以及弹窗里的其余桶位（未缓存输入、缓存读取、缓存写入、输出）都
保持原样，也不改动任何布局尺寸。

dsh-cache-hit-precision README · 效果：弹窗中的「缓存命中」行与底部状态行（`80.9M tok · 缓存命中 99.186%`）都被
原位替换为三位小数读数，界面其余部分与内置渲染完全一致。

dsh-cache-hit-precision README · 为什么需要三位小数：DSH 内置的格式化器有一条好规则：不把部分命中向上舍入成 `100%`——整数读数
会失真时，它会自动加宽小数位，直到那一份未命中可见。本插件把同样的承诺
建立在**三位小数**的起点上，而不是整数起点，让命中率的变化在日常使用中就
能被看见：

| 缓存读取 / 计费输入 | 内置显示   | 本插件显示   |
| ------------------- | ---------- | ------------ |
| 123 / 1123          | `11%`      | `10.953%`    |
| 9995 / 10000        | `99.95%`   | `99.950%`    |
| 999999 / 1000000    | `99.9999%` | `99.9999%`   |
| 9995 / 9995         | `100%`     | `100.000%`   |

dsh-cache-hit-precision README · 为什么需要三位小数：分母与 DSH 完全一致，即三个互不重叠的输入侧计费桶之和：
`uncachedInputTokens + cacheReadTokens + cacheWriteTokens`。因此两者只可能在
**精度**上不同，不会在**口径**上不同。舍入采用精确整数运算的半进位，百分比
不会带上浮点误差。

dsh-cache-hit-precision README · 工作原理：精化是即时的：内置弹窗首帧以整数精度渲染，因此每当锚点新挂载或 React 原位
改写读数时，插件都在 mutation observer 自己的微任务里重新精化——在 React
提交之后、浏览器绘制之前完成，低精度首帧不会被看到；其余变更仍按 burst
结束后的一次去抖重扫处理。

插件锚定统计行里缓存命中读数所在的那一个 pill——DSH 0.2.0 之前是包住整行的
`data-composer-stats` 容器，0.2.1 起是各 pill 独立的 `data-composer-stat`（只认
`usage` 那一个，`activity` 只放轮次与速度）——以及会话用量弹窗行列表的
`data-session-stats-usage` 属性、内置的两种语言文案，因此能跨两代统计行结构
与次要的主题、布局调整继续工作。

dsh-cache-hit-precision README · 安装：**按包名安装（推荐）** —— 包已发布到 npm。桌面端打开「设置 → 插件」，点
「添加插件」，直接填包名 `dsh-cache-hit-precision` 再点「安装」；命令行等价于：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cache-hit-precision
```

刚发布的版本在 npmmirror 镜像上可能有几分钟延迟；安装对话框和 CLI 都会在
官方源与镜像之间自动回退，CLI 也可以用 `--registry` 显式指定源。

**按目录安装** —— 也可以从源码目录安装。先把仓库克隆到本地：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/vrvtvy/dsh-cache-hit-precision.git
```

桌面端「设置 → 插件 → 添加插件」填克隆目录的**绝对路径**；命令行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-cache-hit-precision
```

dsh-cache-hit-precision README · 安装：路径必须是绝对路径；正斜杠在各平台都可用（Windows 用 `D:/…`，其它平台用
`/home/you/…`）。安装完成后重启 DSH。

桌面端独占管理自己的 profile，因此命令行会拒绝 `--profile desktop`；那种情况
请改用「设置 → 插件」。

dsh-cache-hit-precision README · 兼容性：面向 DSH `0.2.0-rc.*` 与 `0.2.1-rc.*`（分别在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 与 `0.2.1-rc.2` 上验证）。
统计行由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat` 的 `StatsPills` 渲染；0.2.1 起该行拆成每个
pill 一个 dock entry，锚点从整行容器改为单个 pill，插件同时认两套锚点。若上游重做了
相关结构或文案，可能需要更新本插件。

每轮用量面板（`data-turn-usage-details`）被**有意**排除在外：它的缓存命中率是
另一个口径——单轮而非整个会话——改写成 pill 的数字反而会误报。

DSH `0.1.x` 的统计行实现不同，本版本不支持。

dsh-cache-hit-precision README · 说明：- 不请求网络，不上传任何数据。
- 只注册一个 slot 条目，不注入样式；卸载后不留残留。

dsh-cache-hit-precision README · 测试：```sh
npm test
```

dsh-cache-hit-precision README · dsh-cache-hit-precision：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/) (DSH)
Web plugin: it renders the built-in cache-hit reading of the composer statistics
row with **three-decimal precision in place** (`缓存命中 98%` ->
`缓存命中 98.460%`), and keeps the same reading in the *Token usage* dialog and
the status line in step.

dsh-cache-hit-precision README · dsh-cache-hit-precision：Nothing is added to the UI. The plugin claims an invisible seat in the composer
dock, reads the same `tokenUsage` projection the built-in pill reads, and
refines only the cache-hit reading — turns, steps, throughput, totals, and the
dialog's other buckets (uncached input, cache read, cache write, output) are
untouched. No geometry is changed.

dsh-cache-hit-precision README · What it looks like：Both the *cache hit* row of the dialog and the status line
(`80.9M tok · 缓存命中 99.186%`) are replaced in place with the three-decimal
reading; everything else matches the built-in rendering exactly.

dsh-cache-hit-precision README · Why three decimals：The built-in formatter refuses to round a partial hit up to `100%`: it prints
an integer until that would collapse, then widens the precision until the miss
is visible. This readout keeps that promise from a three-decimal base instead
of an integer one, so day-to-day movements of the hit rate stay visible:

dsh-cache-hit-precision README · Why three decimals：The denominator is DSH's own — the sum of the three disjoint prompt-side
billing buckets, `uncachedInputTokens + cacheReadTokens + cacheWriteTokens` —
so the two readings can only differ in precision, never in meaning. Rounding is
half-up in exact integer arithmetic, so a percentage never inherits float
drift.

dsh-cache-hit-precision README · How it works：Refinement is immediate: the built-in dialog renders its first frame at integer
precision, so the plugin re-refines inside the mutation observer's own
microtask — after React's commit, before the browser paints — whenever an
anchor mounts or React rewrites a reading in place. The low-precision first
frame is never seen; anything else settles through one debounced rescan per
mutation burst.

dsh-cache-hit-precision README · How it works：The plugin anchors on whichever pill holds the cache-hit reading — the
`data-composer-stats` container that wrapped the whole statistics row up to
0.2.0, or the per-pill `data-composer-stat` entries that replaced it in 0.2.1
(only `usage`; `activity` carries turns and speed) — and on the
`data-session-stats-usage` attribute of the session usage dialog's row list and
the two shipped locale strings, so it keeps working across both statistics-row
markups and across minor theme and layout changes.

dsh-cache-hit-precision README · Install：**By package name (recommended)** — the package is published to npm. In the
desktop app, open *Settings → Plugins*, click *Add plugin*, and enter the
package name `dsh-cache-hit-precision`; the command line equivalent is:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cache-hit-precision
```

dsh-cache-hit-precision README · Install：A freshly published version may lag a few minutes on the npmmirror mirror; both
the install dialog and the CLI fall back between the official registry and the
mirror automatically, and the CLI accepts `--registry` to pick one explicitly.

**From a directory** — you can also install from a source checkout. Clone the
repository first:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/vrvtvy/dsh-cache-hit-precision.git
```

dsh-cache-hit-precision README · Install：In the desktop app, *Settings → Plugins → Add plugin* with the **absolute
path** of the cloned directory; from the command line:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-cache-hit-precision
```

The path must be absolute; forward slashes work on every platform (`D:/…` on
Windows, `/home/you/…` elsewhere). Restart DSH when the install finishes.

dsh-cache-hit-precision README · Install：The desktop app manages its own profile exclusively, so it refuses
`--profile desktop` from the CLI; use *Settings → Plugins* there instead.

dsh-cache-hit-precision README · Compatibility：Built for DSH `0.2.0-rc.*` and `0.2.1-rc.*` (verified on `0.2.0-rc.2` and
`0.2.1-rc.2`). The composer statistics row is rendered by
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat`'s `StatsPills`; from 0.2.1 that row is one
dock entry per pill, so the anchor moved from the row container to the single
pill and the plugin reads both. An upstream rework of that markup or copy may
require a plugin update.

dsh-cache-hit-precision README · Compatibility：The per-turn usage panel (`data-turn-usage-details`) is deliberately left
alone: its cache-hit reading is a different aggregate — one turn rather than
the whole session — so refining it to the pill's number would misreport it.

DSH `0.1.x` exposed a different stats line and is not supported by this
version.

dsh-cache-hit-precision README · Notes：- Reads no network, uploads nothing.
- Registers one slot entry and no styles; uninstalling leaves no residue.

dsh-cache-hit-precision README · Test：```sh
npm test
```
